items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: they had Willie G. Howard I remember

ctx.x: Guy come up and we were so steeped in

playing jazz and we were playing the early set, they had another band that played for dancing and they had Willie G. Howard I remember, and the guy -- headwaiter came up and said, 'Play a rhumba.' And Dave Barbour said, 'What's that?' We used to drive this guy crazy. You -- What's a rhumba? He's a -- he'd say, 'Play a waltz.' 'Is that one, two, three?' We used to say. And, we got out of there --
